item.description:
### Added - **Clicking a session now opens the exact tab it's running in, in iTerm2 and Terminal.** Until now Perch could only bring those apps to the front and leave you to find the right tab yourself; Warp was the only terminal it could open precisely. Tapping a notification lands in the same place, and replying to a question straight from a notification works in those terminals too.
### Note - The first time you jump to a session in Terminal, macOS asks whether Perch may control it. That's what lets Perch open the right tab. If you decline, clicking simply brings Terminal to the front as before.
